titulo: Quiz — Mi porta, and the bill
introPt: A traveller asks for the bill, reads the two extra lines, and takes the receipt.
cenario: The end of a meal at a trattoria.

dialogo.es: Mi porta il conto, per favore?
dialogo.pt: Could you bring me the bill, please?

dialogo.es: Coperto due euro a persona, servizio dieci per cento.
dialogo.pt: Cover charge two euros per person, service ten percent.

dialogo.es: Mi porta lo scontrino, per favore?
dialogo.pt: Could you bring me the receipt, please?

perguntas.pergunta: Why does the bill not arrive on its own?
opcoes: Bringing it unrequested would be hurrying you out
You have to pay at the till
perguntas.explica: The table is yours until you signal otherwise.

perguntas.pergunta: Is the coperto required by law?
opcoes: No — but it is lawful when clearly indicated on the menu
No, and it is always illegal
perguntas.explica: A coperto that appears nowhere on the menu is the version worth questioning.

perguntas.pergunta: Servizio is on the bill. Should you also tip?
opcoes: No — tipping on top is not expected; rounding up is plenty
perguntas.explica: Italy does not run on tipping.

opcoes: A legal obligation for the business
perguntas.explica: It is also the only document that lets you dispute anything afterwards.

opcoes: Anything that has to physically arrive at your table
perguntas.explica: The bill, water, bread, the receipt.
